body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'Taipei Audio Fair 2006') -- <Visual News>Hannspree booth at Taipei Audio Fair 2006. Hannspree is a newly emerging Taiwanese company that is famous for its fashionable, innovative LCD TVs. Aiming to express unique interests and desires of individuals, it has been inventing more than 100 kinds of models with intriguing designs under three themes; sport, fantasy, and style so far.

With partnership agreement with NBA, WNBA, MLB, and Walt Disney, Hannspree design team have been able to introduce TVs and speakers utilizing their familiar character design. Based on a concept of ‘360-degrees of difference’, Hannspree models are designed to display unique feature according to different angles.

Hannspree products are available in various overseas markets such as USA, Japan, Hong Kong, China, Singapore, New Zealand, Europe, and Taiwan. The company said that it is going to unveil its LCD TVs from 26-inch to 50-inch models based on current design at CES 2006 in January next year.
